request: mix: 正規表現の一致位置が縦に揃うよう各行を空白で整列する / ファイルまたは標準入力のテキストを読み、-e で指定した正規表現の最初の一致が各行で同じ表示桁に来るよう、一致より前に空白を足して整列して出力する。表示幅は全角2桁で数え、一致しない行はそのまま出す。-e のほか、一致の前に入れる最小余白を -p で指定できる。例: -e '=' で「a=1」「long名=2」を入力すると「a    =1」「long名=2」のように = が揃う。コマンド名は alignre

spec.name: alignre
spec.summary: alignre pads lines with spaces so the first match of a regex starts at the same display column on every line.

flags.name: e
flags.help: regular expression (Go syntax) to align on (required)

flags.name: p
flags.help: minimum number of spaces inserted before the match

behavior: B1: -e is required. If it is missing or empty, print "alignre: -e is required" to stderr and exit 2. If -p is negative, print "alignre: -p must be >= 0" to stderr and exit 2. Bad flags exit 2.
B2: Compile -e with Go regexp.Compile. On failure print "alignre: invalid regex: " followed by the error text to stderr, nothing to stdout, exit 1.

B3: Input is the file arguments read in order, or stdin if there are none. All lines of all files form one list. Lines are split on "\n"; a final newline does not create an extra line; empty input has zero lines. "\r" is not special.
B4: If a file cannot be read, print "alignre: " followed by the error text to stderr, write nothing to stdout, exit 1 (all input is read before any output).

B5: For each line find the leftmost first match with FindStringIndex. The prefix is the text before the match start; its width is go-runewidth StringWidth of the prefix (wide characters count 2). An empty match counts as a match.

B6: The target column is the maximum prefix width over all matching lines plus the -p value. Each matching line gets (target - its prefix width) spaces inserted immediately before the match. Lines without a match are unchanged.
B7: Every output line, including the last, is followed by "\n". Exit 0 on success; empty input prints nothing.
